# QR Scanner
Source: https://github.com/nimiq/qr-scanner
Version: npm qr-scanner 1.4.2 (pinned in package-lock.json).
License: MIT, copied from the package. The browser module and worker are copied by scripts/copy-assets.mjs and served locally; no CDN or external scanning service. Used only by the Petugas Absensi scanner. The worker includes the bundled decoder from the upstream distribution.
